from solution import concatenate_elements


def test_issue_example_given():
    """Check adjacent element concatenation matches the documented example."""
    result = concatenate_elements(("DSP ", "IS ", "BEST ", "FOR ", "ALL ", "UTS"))
    # 'DSP '+'IS '='DSP IS ', 'IS '+'BEST '='IS BEST ', 6-1=5 pairs
    assert result == ('DSP IS ', 'IS BEST ', 'BEST FOR ', 'FOR ALL ', 'ALL UTS')


def test_issue_two_elements_single_pair():
    """Check two elements concatenate into one adjacent pair."""
    result = concatenate_elements(("ab", "cd"))
    # 'ab'+'cd'='abcd', 2-1=1 pair
    assert result == ("abcd",)


def test_issue_single_element_empty():
    """Check single element tuple has no adjacent pair."""
    result = concatenate_elements(("solo",))
    # 1-1=0 pairs, so empty tuple
    assert result == ()


def test_issue_empty_tuple_empty():
    """Check empty tuple has no adjacent concatenation."""
    result = concatenate_elements(())
    # 0 elements gives 0 pairs
    assert result == ()


def test_issue_three_elements_two_pairs():
    """Check three elements produce two adjacent concatenations."""
    result = concatenate_elements(("x", "y", "z"))
    # 'x'+'y'='xy', 'y'+'z'='yz', 3-1=2 pairs
    assert result == ("xy", "yz")


def test_issue_strings_without_spaces():
    """Check adjacent concatenation joins strings directly without separator."""
    result = concatenate_elements(("ab", "cd", "ef"))
    # 'ab'+'cd'='abcd', 'cd'+'ef'='cdef', 3-1=2 pairs
    assert result == ("abcd", "cdef")


def test_issue_empty_strings_inside():
    """Check empty strings concatenate with neighbors correctly."""
    result = concatenate_elements(("", "a", ""))
    # ''+'a'='a', 'a'+''='a', 3-1=2 pairs
    assert result == ("a", "a")


def test_issue_length_is_input_minus_one():
    """Check four inputs produce three adjacent pairs."""
    result = concatenate_elements(("p", "q", "r", "s"))
    # 4-1=3 pairs expected
    assert len(result) == 3


def test_contract_result_is_tuple():
    """Check adjacent concatenation returns a tuple."""
    result = concatenate_elements(("a", "b", "c"))
    # 3-1=2 pairs expected as tuple type
    assert isinstance(result, tuple)


def test_contract_empty_result_is_tuple():
    """Check single-element input returns an empty tuple type."""
    result = concatenate_elements(("only",))
    # 1-1=0 pairs, expected type tuple
    assert isinstance(result, tuple)


def test_contract_input_tuple_is_unchanged():
    """Check input tuple is not mutated by concatenation."""
    data = ("m", "n", "o")
    concatenate_elements(data)
    # 3 elements unchanged, 3-1=2 pairs computed without mutation
    assert data == ("m", "n", "o")
